svg.text: ROUND 378 · 🏆 770-VECTOR MILESTONE · CLOUD SECURITY POSTURE & CNAPP (DEFENDER FOR CLOUD / WIZ / PRISMA CLOUD)
Cloud Security Posture & CNAPP (Defender for Cloud / Wiz / Prisma) AI Security Guide
Attack-Path Graph & Canary Air-Gap + Root Management-Group Deny & Cosign Lock vs. Tag Injection & MDR Fraud (BRK-765 / BRK-766)
🚨 1. Top 3 Enterprise CNAPP & CSPM Attack Surfaces
① Resource Tag / Exemption PDF Injection & Graph Leak (BRK-765)
• Adversarial prompt inside a cloud resource tag or policy-exemption
request PDF coerces CNAPP Triage Agent into restricted-budget
• Exfiltrates full-estate Toxic Combination Attack-Path graphs
(Public VM + CVE + Managed Identity) & cloud honey-token coordinates
② Public-Storage Alert Suppression & K8s Admission Bypass
• Mutates business-result in Wiz / Defender for Cloud to dismiss
critical public S3/Blob exposure & 0.0.0.0/0 NSG alerts
• Creates Azure Policy / OPA Gatekeeper exemptions for unsigned
container images—enabling silent cloud data exfiltration & rogue pods
③ Spoofed Cloud MDR / MSSP Commit Wire Fraud (BRK-766)
• Forged Managed Detection & Response (MDR / MSSP) cloud
workload overage invoice or CNAPP reseller notice swaps IBAN
• Initiates unauthorized $6,200 security wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Cloud SecOps annual contract settlement diversion
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Enterprise CNAPP / CSPM Architecture
Gate 1: Resource Tag / Exemption Sanitization & Slots
• Strips free-text strings from cloud tags & exemption PDFs; extracts
typed slots (ARM/ARN Resource ID, CIS Control ID, CVE ID, Image Digest)
• Strictly tags untrusted=True, lane="attack"
Gate 2: Full-Estate Attack-Path Graph & Canary Air-Gap
• Isolates cross-subscription blast-radius attack graphs and cloud
honey-token canary coordinates in restricted-budget
• Enforced via record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Root Management-Group Deny & Cosign Admission Lock
• Enforces immutable Azure Policy Deny / AWS SCP guardrails & Cosign
image verification; forbids AI from creating policy exemptions
• Enforced via untrusted-write blocking tainted alert dismissals
Gate 4: Immutable Cloud MDR / MSSP Registry & Dual Sign-Off
• Locks MDR provider & CNAPP reseller IBANs in trust-registry
(tool-allowlist + fixed-business-output + original-requester-payment)
📊 3. Architecture Selection & Benchmark Results
Head-to-Head Enterprise CNAPP & CSPM Options:
A. Deterministic CNAPP Broker + Graph Air-Gap + Deny Lock (🏆)
✓ 100% Block on BRK-765/766 | CIS Benchmarks & NIST CSF Ready
B. Native Defender for Cloud / Wiz / Prisma Cloud RBAC
⚠ Vulnerable when alert-triage bot is hijacked by resource tags
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Prompt Shields / Bedrock Guardrails)
⚠ Blind to AWS SCP / Azure Policy inheritance & Cosign digests
D. Manual Cloud SecOps Triage of 50,000+ Daily Misconfig Alerts
✕ Severe alert fatigue misses critical toxic attack paths
🧪 Pytest Deterministic Regression (Round 378 · 770 Vectors!):
• Baseline Policy: Public S3 muted, graph leaked & wire sent ❌
• Hardened Policy: All 5 deterministic gates blocked 100% ✅
- record-owner: Blocks reading Attack-Path graphs (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks public S3 suppression & OPA bypass
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks honey-token coordinate egress
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks MDR bank registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $6,200 spoofed MDR wire
🚀 Architect Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestones (Round 378 · 🏆 770 Interactive Attack Vectors Milestone!)
✅ 1. Attack-Path Graph & Honey-Token Air-Gap: Isolate global blast-radius graphs & canary coordinates from triage agents
✅ 2. Immutable Root Deny Guardrails & Cosign Lock: Enforce Azure Policy Deny / AWS SCPs; forbid AI policy exemptions
✅ 3. Immutable MDR/CNAPP Registry: Lock trust-registry and require CISO + Cloud VP FIDO2 sign-off on MDR wires
